description: Retrieve a page of file diffs for a commit, branch, or tag in a project. Configured diff limits can stop pagination before all changed files are returned.

id.description: Project ID or unencoded namespaced project path.
id.title: Id

sha.description: Commit hash or repository branch or tag name.
sha.title: Sha

unidiff.description: Present diffs in unified diff format. GitLab defaults to false.
unidiff.title: Unidiff

name: get_commit_diff

a_mode.description: Old file mode of the file.
a_mode.title: A Mode

b_mode.description: New file mode of the file.
b_mode.title: B Mode

collapsed.description: File diff is excluded but can be fetched on request.
collapsed.title: Collapsed

deleted_file.description: Whether the file has been removed.
deleted_file.title: Deleted File

diff.description: File changes, or null when unavailable.
diff.title: Diff

new_file.description: Whether the file has been added.
new_file.title: New File

renamed_file.description: Whether the file has been renamed.
renamed_file.title: Renamed File

too_large.description: File diff is excluded and cannot be retrieved.
too_large.title: Too Large

diffs.description: File diffs for this response page.
diffs.title: Diffs

next_page.description: Next page number from GitLab, or null on the last page.
next_page.title: Next Page
